interpretation: Group-level calibration diagnostics for all three confidence candidates on all three systems. Every statistic is descriptive: no threshold is selected, no certificate is issued, no finite-sample penalty is applied and the frozen alpha=0.20 headline is untouched. The load-bearing pair is acceptance_permitted_by_base_risk -- one minus the arithmetic minimum abstention (mu-alpha)/(1-alpha), which assumes a PERFECT score and so is not attainable by any real system -- against max_acceptance_within_alpha, the acceptance the measured ranking actually reached. A large gap locates the failure in score discrimination rather than in base risk; normalized_aurc quantifies the same thing on a 0=perfect, 1=chance scale. AUROC is oriented so that higher is better and 0.5 is chance, and AUPRC must be read against failure_prevalence, not against 0.5. The oracle-accepted set used for acceptance_lift is diagnostic and was never certified.
